page.running_head: De Agro Frisi. inter Lavic. & Amasi.

main_text.p: Illustri[?] GENERALIUM ORDI-NUM collegio deputati.sunt tria. Primum est id, quod GENE-RALIUM ORDINUM nomen habet, honore potestateque summum, totius foederis ac Reip. communis caput, à quo cætera pendent, & leges accipiunt, longè lateque inclytum, haud dissimile concilio Achaico veteri, aut Ætolico in Græ-ciâ, aut Panionio in Asiâ, sed perpetuum. Sedes ei Hagæ in Hollandiâ, in quod mittuntur ex omnibus provinciis sociis [illegible, ~6 letters] viri summis. Alterum dignitate & potesta-te proximum huic, bellica potissimum curans. SENATUS ORDINUM nun-Assessores SENATUS ORDINUM. cupatur: quod, quoties res ardua ac magna incidit, quæ consilio decretoque habet opus, in partem curæ & consilii vocatur, & nunc seorsim deliberat de eâ, sententiamque suam ad collegium superius refert, nunc cum eodem in deliberando conjungitur. Eodem quippè loco, eâdem in arce sedem habet, quo expeditior sit conjunctio. Tertium & ipsum illustre & magnarum virium est, MA-MARITIMIS REBUS præfecti,RITIMIS REBUS, quæ maximæ in Belgio sunt, PRAEFECTUM, distin-ctum in collegia minora velut membra totius,

page.notes: The marginal note's first word is set in italic and is uncertain: marked [?]. The final line is only partly legible and is marked as illegible. The first lines of this part are cut at the top and the text starts mid-sentence. The printed "summis" and "sunt" are read through long s as summs and funs, corrected to plain s.
